title: centaurea phrygia subsp. pseudophrygia
intro: Centaurea phrygia subsp. pseudophrygia, commonly known as the "Phrygian cornflower," is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea phrygia subsp. pseudophrygia include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
